question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Who would you want to hang out with most?

nodes.text: Ben heroically pushes Amanda out of the way, just as the glacier comes tumbling down!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: That was close!
A small crowd, alerted by the crash, gathers around them.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What happened?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I guess... Snow hates me!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Apparently. This was almost an ugly repeat of the `Snow Machine Incident.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Apparently. This was almost an ugly repeat of the [color=#e23b3b][i]Snow Machine Incident.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But luckily you're okay this time!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, good work, Ben. I owe you one.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Not exactly... It's my fault the glacier fell in the first place.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I just got so mad... I started punching it!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, no harm, no foul. Amanda is okay, and you learned a lesson.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Did I? I still feel just as mad as ever!
Ben kicks the snow.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: What's going on here? I `know` the school didn't approve the usage of another snow machine!
nodes.text_bbcode: What's going on here? I [color=#3b78e2][i]know[/i][/color] the school didn't approve the usage of another snow machine!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: $Scott, is this your doing?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Not this time!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It was me...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Ben... Snow is `not` something you play around with!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ben... Snow is [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] something you play around with!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Er... Unless you're building a snowman or having a snowball fight.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: The point is, you don't play around with it `inside the school!`
nodes.text_bbcode: The point is, you don't play around with it [color=#3b78e2][i]inside the school![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: You just earned yourself a trip to `detention!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You just earned yourself a trip to [color=#3b78e2][i]detention![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I... I'm going to go call my uncle. I'll see you later, Ben.
She leaves, and Ben stands all by himself next to his science project.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Even the girl who's supposed to be my best friend doesn't have time for me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What if my mom was right about me?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What if it's `my` fault for putting academics ahead of everything else for so long?
nodes.text_bbcode: What if it's [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] fault for putting academics ahead of everything else for so long?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Stupid... Glacier!
Ben punches the huge mound of ice.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Grrr!!!
He punches it again... And the glacier begins to wobble on top of its display table.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh oh... I think it's going to fall!
Suddenly, Amanda walks into the room.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Is this where the `fair` is?
nodes.text_bbcode: Is this where the [color=#3b78e2][i]fair[/i][/color] is?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Wait... Where are the rides?
The tower of ice teeters and begins to fall... Right toward Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Amanda, watch out!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That doesn't seem true... I'm not even very good at science.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Are you kidding? You're the second best scientist in the club!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm the only scientist in the club besides you!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's `technically` true...
nodes.text_bbcode: That's [color=#e23b3b][i]technically[/i][/color] true...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But I... I just can't concentrate on academics when my heart feels like it's being ripped out of my chest.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Why can't you understand that?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Some people` can concentrate on academics no matter what.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Some people[/i][/color] can concentrate on academics no matter what.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You `need` me?
nodes.text_bbcode: You [color=#3b78e2][i]need[/i][/color] me?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I... I'm just going through a really tough time right now.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Aw... Ben. Come here.
Denni reaches over and gives Ben a big hug.
And when she pulls back.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Denni, I...
He leans in... So close that he can feel her breath against his lips.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ben, I...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I... I can't... I can't be here with you right now!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Denni, wait!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry, guys... I guess I messed up.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Worst... Day... Ever.
Later...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Where is everyone? The Science Fair is supposed to start any minute!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Maybe the Wilson High kids got scared when they saw your awesome `model glacier?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe the Wilson High kids got scared when they saw your awesome [color=#3b78e2][i]model glacier?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: A huge tower of ice sits on a table next to Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Huh. It's possible that they were intimidated...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But it's also possible that Howard and Hector were right...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What if the Wilson kids really `are` here to cause trouble?
nodes.text_bbcode: What if the Wilson kids really [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] here to cause trouble?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ben? Is everything okay?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Everything is fine...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The two of us can have a science fair all by ourselves!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait. Where's `your` experiment?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait. Where's [color=#e23b3b][i]your[/i][/color] experiment?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh... About that...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I've been so worried about Colt lately that I can't get any work done!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: In fact... I think I might call my uncle to see if he can investigate Colt's whereabouts.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Your uncle?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: He's a big-time police officer over in San Francisco!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait... Are you saying you `didn't do a science project?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait... Are you saying you [color=#e23b3b][i]didn't do a science project?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Please don't be mad. I just have more important stuff on my mind.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You mean Colt. It's always Colt.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Don't you see, Denni?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Your family, huh? I guess I can understand that...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If I were ever worried about my parents... Or any of my little sisters...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, let's just say I understand.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I still wish you hadn't invited those Wilson kids into our school.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Science? Science? Who cares about science at a time like this?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Me?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Real stuff is at stake here, Ben. The school's honor. `Our` honor.
nodes.text_bbcode: Real stuff is at stake here, Ben. The school's honor. [color=#e23b3b][i]Our[/i][/color] honor.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `You` invited those Wilson kids here.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]You[/i][/color] invited those Wilson kids here.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And if anything should happen, it's `your` responsibility.
nodes.text_bbcode: And if anything should happen, it's [color=#e23b3b][i]your[/i][/color] responsibility.

nodes.text: He turns and walks away.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sigh... Just one more thing to worry about.
Later, in study hall...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Is everything okay? We heard there was a fight!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It was just Spencer being Spencer...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Are you kidding? We don't have time for internal squabbling today!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah... There are Wilson kids everywhere!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, yeah. They're here for the science fair at lunch. I `invited` them.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, yeah. They're here for the science fair at lunch. I [color=#e23b3b][i]invited[/i][/color] them.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You `what?` Don't you know the rules?
nodes.text_bbcode: You [color=#e23b3b][i]what?[/i][/color] Don't you know the rules?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah... They can't come in unless you invite them in!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Isn't that the rule for vampires?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Vampires `and` Wilson High kids!
nodes.text_bbcode: Vampires [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] Wilson High kids!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How could this have happened?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You gave the Wilson kids an excuse to be here on campus with less than a month before our big Homecoming game against them!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I `know` they're planning something...
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]know[/i][/color] they're planning something...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah something is definitely going on...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You know how we're planning a big Homecoming Bonfire in the park tonight?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, they're planning a rival bonfire `right next to us!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, they're planning a rival bonfire [color=#e23b3b][i]right next to us![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Don't you have any school spirit at all?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I've just got bigger things to worry about right now, okay?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What could possibly be more important than school spirit?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's...
Spencer hits Ben right in the face!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ow!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey! You almost dripped blood on my `new shoes!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey! You almost dripped blood on my [color=#e23b3b][i]new shoes![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's from my nose!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: What's going on here, boys?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: He hit me!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: So? Kids hit each other all the time. Is it `my` job to do something about it?
nodes.text_bbcode: So? Kids hit each other all the time. Is it [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] job to do something about it?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, it is, actually.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I knew no one would care. A couple of weeks ago, she was all set to make 'Fist Club' an official school activity!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Consider that punch your `official` induction into an `unofficial` after-school club.
nodes.text_bbcode: Consider that punch your [color=#e23b3b][i]official[/i][/color] induction into an [color=#e23b3b][i]unofficial[/i][/color] after-school club.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Now wait just a second... Fighting is one thing...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: But I won't have you founding unofficial clubs. That challenges my authority!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Maybe a little time in detention will show you who's in charge around here.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But I... I just wanted to hit him!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: We're done here.
She heads down the hall.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: This is your fault, Kale. Next time I see you, you're getting punched... Again!
Ben ducks out of the way and Spencer hits the school trophy case, shattering the glass!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oops!
Spencer tries to step back, and glass crunches under his feet.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `My new shoes!` I paid 200 bucks for these! Now the bottoms are getting all cut up!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]My new shoes![/i][/color] I paid 200 bucks for these! Now the bottoms are getting all cut up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `No one` messes with my shoes!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]No one[/i][/color] messes with my shoes!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Are you seriously blaming `me` for this?
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you seriously blaming [color=#e23b3b][i]me[/i][/color] for this?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: What's going on here?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I... Er... Was trying to clean the glass. With my fist.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Sigh... I like you, Spencer, but you lie about as well as my ex-boyfriends.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Now, normally, I wouldn't even mind a little property damage.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: But it just so happens that `my high school wrestling trophies` are in that case!
nodes.text_bbcode: But it just so happens that [color=#3b78e2][i]my high school wrestling trophies[/i][/color] are in that case!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh... Sorry?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I mean, what's a little broken glass between friends, right?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Those trophies mean a lot more to me than friendship.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: You'll have plenty of time to think about that fact `in detention.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You'll have plenty of time to think about that fact [color=#3b78e2][i]in detention.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: She plucks her trophies out of the broken case.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: My poor babies... Did the bad man hurt you?
She walks down the hall, cooing to her trophies.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: This is your fault, Kale. Next time I see you, you're getting punched.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah. That worked out `so` well for you this time.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah. That worked out [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] well for you this time.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah... Well next time I won't miss.
Later that day...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Thanks `so` much for inviting us here, Ben.
nodes.text_bbcode: Thanks [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] much for inviting us here, Ben.

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Yeah. We're super excited about the, uh, crosstown science thingy.

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: The Crosstown Science `Fair`, you half-wit.
nodes.text_bbcode: The Crosstown Science [color=#3b78e2][i]Fair[/i][/color], you half-wit.

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: And we `do` appreciate the invitation. You're a most `generous` host.
nodes.text_bbcode: And we [color=#3b78e2][i]do[/i][/color] appreciate the invitation. You're a most [color=#3b78e2][i]generous[/i][/color] host.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Now excuse us for a few minutes while we go... Set up our booths.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah... Sure... Whatever.
Ben leaves the Wilson kids and walks away, deep in thought.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can't believe I have to put on the first science fair of the year `today!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't believe I have to put on the first science fair of the year [color=#e23b3b][i]today![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm not sure I'm really up for it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm just too sad... And stressed-out...
Suddenly, he rounds a corner and runs into Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Kale... There you are. I've been `waiting` to catch you alone.
nodes.text_bbcode: Kale... There you are. I've been [color=#e23b3b][i]waiting[/i][/color] to catch you alone.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: 'Fist Club' was my dream... And you ruined it!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But you can't stop me from throwing a punch now and then!
Suddenly, Spencer takes a swing at Ben!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: I... I see.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Well, good luck at the science fair!
He turns and leaves.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Fantastic! I'm working on a cheaper way to produce food coloring.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: First, we extract the green pigment from this `apple peel` and combine it with this `vinegar`...
nodes.text_bbcode: First, we extract the green pigment from this [color=#e23b3b][i]apple peel[/i][/color] and combine it with this [color=#e23b3b][i]vinegar[/i][/color]...

nodes.text: Ben's dad hands him the vinegar.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Okay. Pour about three tablespoons into that cup of apple peel shavings... Now!
Ben pours the vinegar.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Then I just add one pinch of this `secret ingredient` and...
nodes.text_bbcode: Then I just add one pinch of this [color=#e23b3b][i]secret ingredient[/i][/color] and...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Yes! Yes! It's working!
The mixture in the cup turns bright green!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Thanks for all of your help.
He takes the cup and runs back to his office.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: 'Secret ingredient' eh? Maybe I'll just borrow a little for my own experiments later...
Ben slips the canister of the secret ingredient into his pocket.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It was nice to share a moment with Dad...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But does he see me as a son... Or a lab assistant?
And several hours later...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Great work, guys! The statue looks awesome!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's sort of sad we had to scrub all of that mold off. We basically just killed an entire ecosystem.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Do you `ever` stop using big words?
nodes.text_bbcode: Do you [color=#e23b3b][i]ever[/i][/color] stop using big words?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'd punch you right now if I wasn't worried I'd splatter your blood on this nice, clean statue.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What is `up` with you two?
nodes.text_bbcode: What is [color=#e23b3b][i]up[/i][/color] with you two?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Even when something goes `right` you just keep fighting!
nodes.text_bbcode: Even when something goes [color=#e23b3b][i]right[/i][/color] you just keep fighting!

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Bleep.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: He should be four doors down, in that classroom over there.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I... I may have underestimated you, Kale.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Are you actually... Complimenting me?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Just don't get used to it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Here! Take my hand!
Ben pulls Spencer up.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Can you walk?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah. I just tripped, that's all. But thanks for coming back for me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Get to the van.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Incoming!
Skazz, running at full speed, reaches Ben and Spencer...
And Ben dodges to the side and sticks his foot out!
Skazz trips and tumbles down a grassy hill.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Mommeeee!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Not bad, geek. I didn't think you had it in you.
The guys reach the van and get inside.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: There's no point in us `both` getting caught.
nodes.text_bbcode: There's no point in us [color=#e23b3b][i]both[/i][/color] getting caught.

nodes.text: Ben runs for the van.
In the meantime, Spencer gets up and gives Skazz a long, hard stare.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Please... Please don't look at me like that.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You've got two seconds to leave before I introduce you to my two best friends...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I call them 'Fist' and... 'Fist.'

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: I don't want to meet your friends!
He turns and runs.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: I didn't order a retreat! Attack!
Spencer flashes Alexei a smile, then turns and walks to the van.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You made it!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No thanks to you...
Ben and Spencer sneak out a window and land safely outside.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Over here, guys!
From inside the school, Alexei points to Ben and Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: There they are! Get them!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: For Wilson High!
Skazz starts charging toward Ben and Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hurry up, guys! Run for the van!
As Ben and Spencer sprint toward Hector's van, Spencer trips!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oof!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What do I do?
Ben unzips his backpack and opens Barry's cage.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay, buddy. Crawl on in.

nodes.speaker: Barry
nodes.text: Grrr...
Barry leaps at Ben and starts scratching with his razor-sharp claws!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Owwwwwwww! My chest! That was my favorite shirt!

nodes.speaker: Barry
nodes.text: Snarl!
Barry leaps off of Ben, then tries to pounce on him again...
But ends up flying out the window!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Oops?
Spencer runs in.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: More Wilson kids showed up. We've got to go, now!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Where's the badger?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And what happened to your shirt?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: He, uh, kind of attacked me. And ran away.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well... Maybe that's good? At least now they won't have a mascot.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I guess so...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well, there's no time to talk about our feelings now. Let's get out of here!
Ben spies an electric razor on the teacher's desk.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: A bald badger wouldn't be much of a mascot...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But trying to shave Barry isn't going to be much fun.
Ben plugs in the razor and takes Barry out of his cage.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Hold still, okay?

nodes.speaker: Barry
nodes.text: Grrr...
Soon, badger hair is flying everywhere!

nodes.speaker: Barry
nodes.text: Purr...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Would you look at that... He actually likes it!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I guess wearing a warm badger-fur coat in the summer isn't too much fun.
Before long, Ben has shaved Barry completely bald!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hm... But how should I prank Barry?

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Access denied.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Useless as ever...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wait a second... Look over there.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: There's a sign over that classroom's door!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah! It reads 'Barry's Room'!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That entire hack-a-thon was a waste of time!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry... I guess I'm having an off day.
The guys round another corner...
And overhear Alexei talking with Stiletto.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: I am `loving` this lizard tail. I think I'm going to make a wrist watch out of it.
nodes.text_bbcode: I am [color=#e23b3b][i]loving[/i][/color] this lizard tail. I think I'm going to make a wrist watch out of it.

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: ...I can't believe how `easy` it was. That stupid nerd just `invited us in!`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...I can't believe how [color=#3b78e2][i]easy[/i][/color] it was. That stupid nerd just [color=#3b78e2][i]invited us in![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: I almost feel bad for the poor kid. What a sucker.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I say we jump them and take back that tail.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No... We have to think rationally. We can't exactly glue the tail back on Lyle's body.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But we `can` do something to `their` mascot.
nodes.text_bbcode: But we [color=#e23b3b][i]can[/i][/color] do something to [color=#e23b3b][i]their[/i][/color] mascot.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: A counter-attack. I like it.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But how are we going to find the badger?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Simple. I'll just use my phone to hack into the Wilson High computer network. The badger's location should be listed there.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: How long is `that` going to take?
nodes.text_bbcode: How long is [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] going to take?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: About two more seconds... If I can do this right!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Good. Keep it that way. Save it for your therapist.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Maybe I will. Talking with you is like talking to a brick wall anyway!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Thanks. I `love` being compared to a brick wall.
nodes.text_bbcode: Thanks. I [color=#e23b3b][i]love[/i][/color] being compared to a brick wall.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: In fact, maybe I'll make 'The Brick Wall' my Fist Club nickname!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Glad to help.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sorry to hear that.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I was just a kid when my dad split on us.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But don't worry, it gets better with time.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I... I can't believe I just told you about my parents.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're the only one I've said anything to!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Don't worry. I won't tell anyone at school.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You know, you're not as big of a jerk as you pretend to be.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah. Not always.
Ben and Spencer head down the hall...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You know, this feels pretty good. A dangerous mission, deep into enemy territory...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I've always wanted to do something like this.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's not too bad, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I've got to hand it to you, Kale.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I thought you'd be shaking in your boots at this point.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Compared to what I've been going through lately, a little sneaking around is nothing.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh yeah? What's been going on?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I think that's the only question you've ever asked me besides 'where should I hit you?'

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Whatever. Never mind.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No... I mean... It's nice that you asked.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Even Denni didn't ask how I was doing today.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The thing is...

options.label: I don't like to talk about my problems.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: New? That seems unlikely.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: I always hang out at the front desk to see if new people come in.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: That way I can hit on the new girls before they meet anyone more attractive than me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, uh, we came here while you were... In class?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Yeah, I don't really go to class.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Just let us in or I'm going to punch you in the face.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Okay!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Please don't hit me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wow, nice work, Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sometimes action speak louder than words.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah... I guess so.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Yeah... I know what that's like.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: I'm not very popular either. Maybe I just have a forgettable face.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Alexei has to ask me my name, like, every three days.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Even my mom sometimes asks me who I am.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Sniff... Sniff...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: There, there! We're all in this together. Go Badgers, right?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Sniff... Go Badgers.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: You can head on in.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Huh... Not bad work back there...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Maybe you're good for something after all.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hehe. Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I think it's time for me to make a call...
Two minutes and thirty-seven seconds later...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks for coming to pick us up, buddy.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Are you kidding? Messing up Wilson is what Hectors do best!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So... What's the plan?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Easy. We sneak into Wilson High and cause some mischief.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But how do we get in? Won't they recognize us?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm glad you asked... Did somebody say `'disguises'?`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm glad you asked... Did somebody say [color=#e23b3b][i]'disguises'?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: 'Hector Alonzo' might not be able to break into Wilson High... But 'Vector Alfonso' should have no problem at all!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Let's do this!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's your disguise? A sweatshirt?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Dude, I `always` wear that other shirt. In any other outfit, I look like a completely different person.
nodes.text_bbcode: Dude, I [color=#e23b3b][i]always[/i][/color] wear that other shirt. In any other outfit, I look like a completely different person.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I guess so...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What about us? Don't we need costumes?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh... The Wilson kids don't know you that well. I figured only Howard and I would need disguises.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay...
A few minutes later, outside of Wilson High.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hello, fellow student.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... Go Badgers!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Nice try, Hector and Howard. But even I'm not dumb enough to fall for those disguises.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What are you talking about? I'm `Vector Alfonso!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What are you talking about? I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]Vector Alfonso![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Just... Just go. I have to guard this door, and you're embarassing yourselves.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: You'd better hurry... I'd hate to have to call Stiletto over here.
As Howard and Hector turn and walk away, Howard leans over and whispers to Ben.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: See if you can sneak in... We'll have the van ready to go if you need to make a getaway.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: What's he whispering to you?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Just threats! He keeps saying mean stuff about `our` school.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... Just threats! He keeps saying mean stuff about [color=#e23b3b][i]our[/i][/color] school.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Wait... You go to Wilson High? How come I've never seen you before?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We're, uh...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: For Lyle's honor and our own... We can't let them get away with this.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I like that enthusiasm!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I knew the school spirit bug would eventually bite you!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Seriously? You don't want to go kick some Wilson butt right now?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The truth is... Lizards lose their tails all the time!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And I actually `like` the way my shoes look with this paint.
nodes.text_bbcode: And I actually [color=#e23b3b][i]like[/i][/color] the way my shoes look with this paint.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's kind of... Artistic.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: We'll see how 'artistic' your face looks after I rearrange it!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Wait. I'm all for art, but I don't `really` want to look like a Picasso.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... Wait. I'm all for art, but I don't [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] want to look like a Picasso.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Every high-culture reference you make just makes me want to hit you more.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Fine, fine. Whatever. I'll go with you guys.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: A little enthusiasm might be nice.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll go, but I don't have to like it. It's like I said before... 'Meh.'

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... What I meant was 'Meh!' A very `enthusiastic` 'Meh!'
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... What I meant was 'Meh!' A very [color=#e23b3b][i]enthusiastic[/i][/color] 'Meh!'

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... I guess that's better.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Let's do this thing.
Several hours later...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay... I'm done with my section.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Me too.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oops! Uh... I know I was supposed to clean the statue's feet...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But all I finished was this one toe.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Are you `joking?` We're going to have to be here all night!
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you [color=#e23b3b][i]joking?[/i][/color] We're going to have to be here all night!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Excuse me if I'm eating into your busy schedule...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm sure you're missing some very important opportunities to pick fights with random strangers.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: The only person I want to punch right now is you, nerd-breath.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Can't you two stop fighting for like five seconds?!
After school...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: I can't believe I'm actually `in detention!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't believe I'm actually [color=#e23b3b][i]in detention![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: What do people even do here?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: `You!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]You![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Look, Spencer, just stay on the other side of the room, okay?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm starting to get the feeling that if we don't keep away from each other, we'll be here all year.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sounds `fine` to me.
nodes.text_bbcode: Sounds [color=#e23b3b][i]fine[/i][/color] to me.

nodes.text: Howard walks in.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey guys.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Howard? What are `you` doing here?
nodes.text_bbcode: Howard? What are [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] doing here?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, I was trying to figure out what the Wilson kids were up to...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And I tracked them down outside the science lab where we keep our school mascot, Lyle.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But just as I was about to confront them, Ms. Lee nabbed me.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `Apparently` I was supposed to be in History class.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Apparently[/i][/color] I was supposed to be in History class.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But how could I be expected to attend class when Wilson kids are clearly planning something?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Do you think they're going to do something to Lyle?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: They'd better not...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If they so much as touch one scale on that lizard's back, I'm gonna...
Ms. Lee enters the room.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Okay, everyone, listen up!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: For today's detention activity, you'll be cleaning the lizard statue in front of the school.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That seems like an odd task. I've never heard of anyone cleaning that statue before.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: No one `has` cleaned it before. That's why it's so dirty.
nodes.text_bbcode: No one [color=#3b78e2][i]has[/i][/color] cleaned it before. That's why it's so dirty.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Great...
Later...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wow. Ms. Lee wasn't kidding. Who knew this statue was so dirty?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The mold has mold! And `THAT` mold has more mold!
nodes.text_bbcode: The mold has mold! And [color=#e23b3b][i]THAT[/i][/color] mold has more mold!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well... I guess it's not going to clean itself.
Each guy takes a sponge in one hand and steel wool in the other...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, guys... Scrub hard! I want to get this thing cleaned up so we can get out of here.
Time passes as the guys scrub...

nodes.prompt: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You may have them fooled, but not me.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You're no hero... You left me to get caught!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Er... Uh... Yeah. Sorry about that.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Barry the badger is bald as a baby seal!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That's what I call justice. By the time his hair grows back, so will Lyle's tail.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You have to remember the real enemy here... Wilson High!
Suddenly, a car full of Wilson High kids drives up.

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Hope your cleaning is going well, boys...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Yes. It would be a `real shame` if something happened that messed up all of your hard work.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes. It would be a [color=#e23b3b][i]real shame[/i][/color] if something happened that messed up all of your hard work.

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Heh-heh. Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: That line was your cue to throw the buckets of paint, idiot.

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Oh, right.
Darren picks up buckets of blue and gold paint and throws them at the statue!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Nooooo!
Howard tries to throw himself in front of the paint, but he's too late!
The statue is covered in blue and gold!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey! We spent the last three hours cleaning that!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And it'll take a lot longer to clean all of the paint off.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Too bad. Looks like you've got a long night ahead of you.

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Heh-heh. You tell 'em, Alexei.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whatever, Alexei... We'll just hose it off. You call this a prank?

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: No... I call `this` a prank!
nodes.text_bbcode: No... I call [color=#e23b3b][i]this[/i][/color] a prank!

nodes.text: Alexei reaches into his jacket... And pulls out Lyle's tail!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Don't worry, boys. It'll grow back... Eventually.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: In the meantime, though, your `stupid` mascot is gonna look even more... Uh... `Stupid!`
nodes.text_bbcode: In the meantime, though, your [color=#e23b3b][i]stupid[/i][/color] mascot is gonna look even more... Uh... [color=#e23b3b][i]Stupid![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Heh-heh. Heh-heh.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Okay, Stiletto. Drive.
The car full of Wilson kids drives off.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Lyle... How humiliating.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's not even the worst part. Look at our sneakers!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: They're covered in paint too!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's it...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You can attack my school, throw paint on my statue, steal my mascot...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But don't you `ever` mess with my shoes!
nodes.text_bbcode: But don't you [color=#e23b3b][i]ever[/i][/color] mess with my shoes!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: For once, I agree. This means war.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait a second... Are you guys saying you want to get revenge on Wilson High?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Big time.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What about you, Ben?
Suddenly, Alexei and the other Wilson kids approach.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: `You!` Ben Kale. That's your name, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]You![/i][/color] Ben Kale. That's your name, right?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's right.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: You messed with the wrong badger, kid. I'm not going to forget this.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Good. I hope you don't.

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: S... Scary!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Alexei... I'm going to go put a Wilson sweatshirt on Barry... It's embarassing to see him like this.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: You'd better watch out, Kale... You just made the wrong enemy.
Alexei and the others turn and walk back to their bonfire.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Awesome. You just got `threatened!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Awesome. You just got [color=#e23b3b][i]threatened![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Trust me, it wasn't as fun as it seemed.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Aw... Don't worry about him, Ben. He's all talk.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You did some nice work, Ben and Spencer! I knew you had it in you!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Had `what` in us?
nodes.text_bbcode: Had [color=#e23b3b][i]what[/i][/color] in us?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: School spirit, of course!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, everyone! Check out what Ben and Spencer did.
He passes his binoculars to Amanda and a few others.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You guys are heroes!
All four of the Homecoming Princesses run over!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We heard about Barry the Badger! Nice going, guys!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah. You do all of us Homecoming Princesses honor through your knightly deeds!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I wish I could have seen you kick some Wilson tail.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Good work, you two! You're both winners in my book!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's pretty clear what's happening, don't you think, Hector?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: The next generation is rising fast...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Maybe you two are the new dynamic duo that'll defend Centerscore when Hector and I can't!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yep. Ben and Spencer. Best buds! Defenders of Centerscore High!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Me and Spencer... Friends?
Spencer leans over and whispers to Ben.
Hector runs up and puts an arm around Ben and Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So... How does it feel?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How does what feel?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: To be the toast of the town?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: If you guys play this right, you might be the most popular guys in school!
Well... This is certainly unexpected.
Ben and Spencer... Suddenly popular?
We'll have to see how this develops in future episodes!

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing!

nodes.text: Suddenly, they hear footsteps coming down the hall.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Well, well, well. If it isn't our favorite statue-cleaners.

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: You're on the wrong side of town, boys.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You get the badger, Ben. I'll hold off these two in the meantime.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're going to fight both of them?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Never underestimate the power...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Of `FIST CLUB!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Of [color=#e23b3b][i]FIST CLUB![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Screaming his head off, Spencer charges at Alexei and Stiletto.
He tackles Alexei to the ground!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoa! That was a viscious tackle!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Stiletto, help!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Sigh. Two against one isn't usually my style.

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: But then again, this guy seems like an unusually tough opponent.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What are you waiting for, Ben? I told you, I've got this. `Go!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What are you waiting for, Ben? I told you, I've got this. [color=#e23b3b][i]Go![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Ben runs into the classroom to find Barry the Badger in a large cage.

nodes.speaker: Barry
nodes.text: Grr...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh oh... He looks a little menacing.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This isn't going to be easy...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And I'm not even sure what to do... Should I...

options.label: Play a prank on him right here.

nodes.text: Suddenly, Spencer runs in.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: More Wilson kids showed up. We've got to go, now!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: The badger looks `perfect` by the way.
nodes.text_bbcode: The badger looks [color=#e23b3b][i]perfect[/i][/color] by the way.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hehe. Thanks.
The glacier falls right on top of Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: My leg!
A small crowd, alerted by the crash, gathers around them.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What happened?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I guess... Snow hates me!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Who's responsible for this?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Er... I kind of, accidentally broke Amanda's leg.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Ben! That is `completely` irresponsible.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ben! That is [color=#e23b3b][i]completely[/i][/color] irresponsible.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait a second, weren't `you` the one who broke her leg during the `Snow Machine Incident?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait a second, weren't [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] the one who broke her leg during the [color=#e23b3b][i]Snow Machine Incident?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yes. Which is `exactly` why I vowed this kind of thing would never happen again.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes. Which is [color=#e23b3b][i]exactly[/i][/color] why I vowed this kind of thing would never happen again.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What... What's my punishment?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: One that fits your crime...
A week later...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can't believe they actually banished me to Alaska.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I guess at least I can take the opportunity to look at some `real` glaciers.
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess at least I can take the opportunity to look at some [color=#e23b3b][i]real[/i][/color] glaciers.

nodes.text: Ben stares at the massive chunks of ice.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well... That was interesting for about five seconds. Now what?
Now what indeed?
You `can't` let things turn out like this.
nodes.text_bbcode: You [b]can't[/b] let things turn out like this.

nodes.text: Time to start over and earn an ending that doesn't end in the frozen north!

args.text: Surviving High School
Try again!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Nice work, boys. You definitely did a great job helping us!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: 'Helping'? What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah. We did `everything!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah. We did [color=#e23b3b][i]everything![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... You went into Wilson...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But `we're` the ones who caught the badger!
nodes.text_bbcode: But [color=#e23b3b][i]we're[/i][/color] the ones who caught the badger!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yep. We saw him run out of the school... And then we grabbed him!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Just another day in the life of the dynamic duo... Hector and Howard!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I guess that's good... But why do I somehow feel like this is a letdown?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Let's head to the Homecoming Bonfire and tell everyone about our adventure!
Later that night...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...And then Hector shouted 'Geronimo' and grabbed Barry.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You're a hero!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hehe. Hector and Howard are `always` saving the day!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hehe. Hector and Howard are [color=#3b78e2][i]always[/i][/color] saving the day!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's true... You guys are pretty awesome.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Now, now, ladies. No need to fawn over us. We're just doing what we always do.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey! We helped too!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah! Howard told us! You two are really good sidekicks!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: We did practically everything!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Except actually capture the badger.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Grrr... This is `your` fault, Kale!
nodes.text_bbcode: Grrr... This is [color=#e23b3b][i]your[/i][/color] fault, Kale!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: We could have been heroes...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Instead, we're just a joke.
Come on! You `don't` let a badger just slip through your fingers like that!
nodes.text_bbcode: Come on! You [b]don't[/b] let a badger just slip through your fingers like that!

nodes.text: Time to start over, and earn an ending where Ben and Spencer are more than just sidekicks!

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Drive, Hector! Go, go, go!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Wait! Where's the badger?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh, you'll see what we did to the badger soon enough.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Let's head to the Homecoming Bonfire...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And we can watch the rival Wilson Bonfire through my binoculars.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You carry binoculars everywhere you go, too?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Of course! I'm a `big-time` bird-watcher. Are you too?
nodes.text_bbcode: Of course! I'm a [color=#e23b3b][i]big-time[/i][/color] bird-watcher. Are you too?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh, birds. Yeah. I like watching birds too.
Later...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There you guys are! I was starting to get worried!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Did you hear what happened to Lyle?! The Wilson guys stole his tail!

nodes.speaker: Lyle
nodes.text: Gweh! Gweh!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's okay, little buddy.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah. Let's just say we've evened the scales.
Ben hands Howard a pair of binoculars. Howard looks across the park at the nearby Wilson High bonfire.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Let's get out of here!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Not so fast.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's the cops! Er, 'the cop'.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I don't need any backup to take down four punks like you. Out of the car.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: You messed with Wilson High for the last time, losers.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: I just hope you have plenty of time to think about what you did to Barry...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: While you cool your heels in jail.
An hour later...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can't believe they just threw us here in a dark cell.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: This is your fault, Kale. You've been messing things up all day.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I should have known you'd get us thrown in jail.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Don't worry, boys! I'm sure we'll get out soon.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Trust me, things aren't so bad.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah. They could be `way` worse.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah. They could be [color=#e23b3b][i]way[/i][/color] worse.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey. I think something just brushed against my leg.

nodes.speaker: Barry
nodes.text: Grrr...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: After hearing what you did to that poor badger, I felt like justice could only be served one way.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: We'll let Barry inflict his own brand of punishment!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Don't worry, guys. Badgers usually only attack when they're hungry.
Suddenly, Officer Monte throws a piece of raw steak at Ben! It slides down the front of his shirt!

nodes.speaker: Barry
nodes.text: ROWR!!!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay. `Now` things are worse!
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay. [color=#e23b3b][i]Now[/i][/color] things are worse!

nodes.text: Our four heroes trapped in a dark cell with an angry badger...
Somehow, we get the feeling that this `isn't` the best ending.
nodes.text_bbcode: Somehow, we get the feeling that this [b]isn't[/b] the best ending.

nodes.text: In cases like this, the thing to do is start over and try again...

Later that night...
There you are, Ben. I was wondering what was keeping you.
Actually... It was a pretty crazy day...
Sounds like that `science fair` must have turned into an all-night affair! Good work.
Uh, no. What actually happened was...
Unfortunately, I have to get back to the lab. Otherwise I'd `love` to hear your story.
Uh... The number for 'The Pizza Man' is on the fridge. Order anything you'd like!
Have a good night, okay?
Yeah... Sure.
Ben's dad rushes out the door, and Ben stands all alone in the living room.
He didn't even want to hear what I had to say.
All he cares about is his stupid job... Stupid science.
I can't believe... I can't believe I spent so long wanting to be like `him.`
The next day...
Ben! There you are!
Oh, uh, hey.
I just wanted to come by and apologize for running out on you yesterday.
I `am` really worried about Colt.
But it seems like you're going through a rough time...
And I want to be here for you, too.
That's why I stayed up `all night` working on my idea for our next Science Fair!
Denni, stop...
But... But you haven't even heard what it is yet?
It's not that. It's the Science Club.
I've spent my whole life trying to be like my dad...
I studied when everyone else was out at parties.
Do you realize I've never even had a girlfriend? Or a kiss?
I... I know.
Yesterday, being over there at Wilson High...
It was the first time I actually felt alive... Maybe ever.
So... The Science Club is done. It's time for me to start living my life.
And... I want you to be part of that.
Ben leans in toward Denni...
Ben... You know how amazing I think you are.
But I still have too many feelings to sort through. I just don't know if...
Hey, it's okay.
I know how much Colt means to you.
If you ever do figure things out, let me know.
Just don't expect me to wait around forever, okay?
Ben leans in and kisses Denni lightly on the cheek.
I'll see you around, okay?
Yeah... I'll... See you around.
Ben walks out, and Denni stands alone in the empty science classroom.
Ben...
Huh... It looks like Ben is making a few changes.
As for what that means for him and Denni...
Well, you'll just have to wait and see!
See you next time!

nodes.title: Ben's Blowup
nodes.subtitle: A guy can only be pushed so far...

nodes.text: Things have been rough for Ben lately...
Denni is too busy to talk, Spencer has been messing with him...
And his parents are getting divorced!
It's a lot for anyone to handle... Especially someone who tends to bottle up his emotions...

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Well? Say `something.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well? Say [i]something.[/i]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Mom... It's just... What do you want me to say?

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: It's a very simple question, Benjamin...

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Do you want to live over there with your dad...

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Or would you rather move over here to `New York` and live with me?
nodes.text_bbcode: Or would you rather move over here to [i]New York[/i] and live with me?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The thing is... I just founded the Science Club here.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And I don't want to start over at a new school halfway through the semester.

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: That's what I thought.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Look, I'd better get to school soon. I'm hosting Wilson High for a `Crosstown Science Fair` today!
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, I'd better get to school soon. I'm hosting Wilson High for a [color=#e23b3b][i]Crosstown Science Fair[/i][/color] today!

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: You really are your father's son. Always putting work ahead of everyone else.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Mom... Don't say that. Staying here wasn't an easy decision.

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Wasn't it?
She hangs up.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Mom...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: You're doing the right thing, Ben.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: In fact, as long as you're here, I thought you might want to help me with some of my experiments!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Dad... I...

nodes.text: Wait... I know. They painted our statue in their school colors... So I'll do the same to `their` badger!

nodes.text: All I need to do is make the colors... And I can use my dad's recipe!
Ben frantically searches the room.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yes! Here's a green apple from the trash... And some vinegar from the lab.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And I've still got the `secret ingredient` in my pocket!

nodes.text: Ben carefully mixes all of the ingredients...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: A whole cup of green dye! This should do perfectly!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Here, badger, badger...

nodes.speaker: Barry

Ben pours the dye on Barry, turning his fur bright green!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: With his green and white fur, Barry is sporting our school colors!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Let's see them hold a pep rally with him as their mascot now!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Barry the badger is green and white!

nodes.speaker: Hector

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It looks like even Barry is a Centerscore High fan.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hehe. And it looks like the Wilson kids are a `little` upset.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hehe. And it looks like the Wilson kids are a [color=#e23b3b][i]little[/i][/color] upset.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't know if this exactly makes us buddies...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But thanks for coming back for me. You're not as bad of a guy as I thought.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Thanks?
